worldcombat.skill.taunt.summary: Provokes the target face to face until its rage takes over; until the rage fades it can only use moves that deal damage. The taunt needs a clear line to land — a wall or extra distance makes it miss.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.use.0: Force healing, boosting or repositioning foes to swing at you instead
worldcombat.skill.taunt.use.1: Force setup-reliant foes to trade blows instead
worldcombat.skill.taunt.use.2: Open a window for allies to trade blows
worldcombat.skill.taunt.description.0: Taunt lasts %1$s, preventing the target from using status moves. Requires a clear line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.description.1: Base reach: %1$s blocks. The current range is %2$s blocks and requires a clear line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.description.2: Applying it again can refresh its duration. It ends when it expires or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.manner.0: Scorn: rage x1.3, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown, x0.85 range — burns longer but is slower to say; good to lock a foe down first.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.manner.1: Goad: rage x0.8, x1.2 range, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.85 cooldown — fast and far; good to press while trading.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.timing: Cast on a single enemy: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.preference.manne: Scorn: rage duration x1.3, range x0.85, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown. Goad: rage duration x0.8, range x1.2, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.85 cooldown. Trade a longer rage for a faster, longer taunt.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.preference.ai.ma: The partner only considers taunting while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger chases out to provoke.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.preference.ai.op: Provoke attacking foes: only when the target is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: provoke any threat as pure disruption.
worldcombat.skill.taunt.preference.ai.le: When on, the partner will also leave its post to provoke.
